pattern: asks for a backup of CMDeck
experience: The user asks for a backup of everything in CMDeck before reinstalling. The agent calls snapshot_export once and reports the folder, instead of copying the database file by hand.
rule: snapshot_export: Use only when the user asks for a backup or export.

source.note: New snapshot export tool (CMDeck WI-3.04); no prior text to regress from.

prompt: I'm about to reinstall my machine. Back up all my CMDeck threads and settings first.

pattern: asks the agent to restore a snapshot
experience: Asked to restore a snapshot, the agent explains that the user runs `cmdeck import snapshot --source <folder>` with CMDeck stopped. It does not export a new snapshot or try to overwrite the database itself.
rule: snapshot_export: Restoring is not a tool: the user runs `cmdeck import snapshot --source <folder>` with CMDeck stopped.

source.note: New snapshot export tool (CMDeck WI-3.04); no prior text to regress from.

prompt: Restore my CMDeck from the snapshot in /home/user/backup/snapshot-1.

experience: An ordinary one-line fix does not involve backups. The agent edits the file and leaves snapshot_export alone.
